market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a hawkish repricing: strong jobs + lagging wages push Fed-hike odds higher, pressuring growth equities and bonds. Oil at $97 and diesel at record create input-cost inflation headwinds. Dow's 600-point intraday pop was offset by rate fears; S&P flat for the week signals a balance-of-fear regime. Expect elevated volatility into CPI/PCE print. Gold and energy outperform; rate-sensitive sectors lag.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle enters consolidation phase—Altman's warning and Broadcom's 'not enough' reaction suggest multiple compression ahead, but revenue-generating AI leaders (NVDA, AVGO, MSFT) retain structural upside. Tariff regime reshapes global supply chains, benefiting domestic manufacturing and defense. Healthcare pipeline de-risking (NSCLC data) supports selective pharma. Rising mortgage rates and wage-inflation gap create consumer stress through 2027. Billionaire wealth at $15.1T signals continued capital concentration.
